schema_notes.axis_loadings: Object keyed by the 8 AXIS_KEYS from scoring.ts. Range -1.0..1.0. Sign convention: POSITIVE = the second pole of the axis name (chaos, maximal, contemporary, expressive, cold, dimensional, abstract, intuition); NEGATIVE = the first pole (order, minimal, classic, functional, warm, flat, literal, system). 0 or absent = axis not expressed by this plate.
schema_notes.status: approved = curated & credited, ready to ship | pending = slot reserved, image + credit still to be curated | retired = removed via CREDITS.md takedown process
schema_notes.capture_modes: plates are eligible for pick, rank, and rate flows unless tags exclude them (rank requires 3 siblings in the same category)
